articles.title: Why Spurs' under-the-radar buy might be summer's smartest deal
articles.summary: Kirsty Hanson swapped Aston Villa for Tottenham and there is reason to believe Spurs have pulled off a recruitment masterstroke, based off her debut at Brisbane Road.
body: A number of stars from overseas have joined the Women's Super League this summer - but after the opening round of fixtures in the 2026-27 season, a move that has gone slightly under the radar could turn out to be more astute than them all.
Kirsty Hanson swapped Aston Villa for Tottenham and her debut suggests Spurs have pulled off a recruitment masterstroke.
Hanson scored twice as Spurs beat West Ham 3-1 on Sunday, with both strikes showing why manager Martin Ho was so keen to bring in the 28-year-old.
The first saw the Scotland international finish a one-on-one chance with enough power that it looped into the net off the goalkeeper's foot.

articles.title: Arsenal v Chelsea: Premier League – live
articles.summary: Minute-by-minute updates from the action at the Emirates Stadium. Arsenal bank on continuity after window closes | Mail Rob. Control v chaos. On the one hand, the forces of order, regimented, playing in precise patterns and, on the other, something darker, more visceral, a method that acknowledges…
body: When it began, a decade ago, that’s how the Pep Guardiola v Jürgen Klopp rivalry appeared. Apollo v Dionysius. Two fundamentally opposed ways of seeing the world. But in time, the two crept towards each other. Klopp moved away from the heavy metal of his Borussia Dortmund years to something more conservative. Guardiola experimented in multiple directions, slowly abandoning the possession-oriented idealism of his past to something less radical but also less predictable.

No goals, no thrills, but an absorbing encounter. It ought to be 1-1: Cunha should have scored for United and Barry for Everton, only for both attempts to go over the bar when it looked easier to get them on target.

On xG, there’s not a lot to separate the teams. Everton 0.34-0.32 United. The United forward line has been the more imposing of the two, but James Garner, who captained their Under-21s before being brainlessly sold to Everton, has been the main man in midfield. And Jarrod Branthwaite, who was coveted by United a couple of summers ago, has been immense in defence.

articles.title: Embattled Fifa president Infantino declares intention to stand for re-election
articles.summary: Infantino is under pressure to resign. Uefa has led calls for president to quit. The Fifa president, Gianni Infantino, has reiterated his desire to stand for re-election despite the continuing controversy surrounding his leadership.
body: Infantino refused to answer questions about his future when asked by reporters at the Women’s Under-20 World Cup in Poland on Saturday. The 56-year-old Swiss is under severe pressure to resign after trying to sell stakes in Fifa tournaments, including the World Cup, to private investors.

Uefa, the European governing body, has led calls for Infantino to step down with further opposition coming from the Asian confederation and Concacaf, which represents countries in North and Central America plus the Caribbean.

But for the first time since the plan became public, FIFA has reiterated Infantino’s intention to run for a fourth and final term in next year’s elections. Should he be re-elected, he will continue to serve as head of world football until 2031.
A Fifa spokesperson said: “The Fifa president announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027. Of course, nothing has changed. Mr Infantino will be standing for re-election.”

articles.title: McColgan wins London Big Half after five months out
articles.summary: Britain's Eilish McColgan returns to competitive action after five months out with a fractured foot to win the London Big Half for a fourth time.
body: Eilish McColgan claimed her fourth victory at the Big Half in London on Sunday after returning to action following five months out with a fractured foot.

The 35-year-old Scot suffered the injury during the London Marathon in April, crossing the line in seventh place with blood seeping through her shoe, and was forced to pull out of July's Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
But McColgan showed the benefit of months of warm weather training, completing a comfortable victory over the 13.1-mile course back in the English capital.
The British women's half-marathon record holder beat last year's winner Jessica Warner-Judd by one minute 19 seconds, finishing in a time of 1hr 10mins 54secs.

articles.title: Liverpool FC’s New Speed Merchants Bradley Barcola and Victor Munoz
articles.summary: When new head coach Andoni Iraola was announced it was soon clear that an essential part of his style demanded pacy wingers which was music to the ears of Reds supporters because we had just survived one of the slowest approaches to play in the previous season.
body: There was a time not too far back where Liverpool boasted one of the greatest ever attacking units in football of Mohamed Salah, Sadio Mane and Roberto Firmino. All three complimented each other with Firmino the purely selfless one who took joy in setting up Mo and Mane with some outrageous flicks and tricks plus the uncanny way of knowing exactly where the other two would be without needing to look. Something else though was the shear power and pace that sucked the air out of opponents who were left wondering how their attack was suddenly turned into a goal down the other end of the pitch for Liverpool.

Coming back to the present and even though it’s early days there is no denying that the Reds have pace to burn down the wings with new signings Barcola and Munoz. Of course there is more to just running fast but it seems that both have skills to match and the lesser known Munoz already has an assist via being fouled in the penalty box after bursting into it with the ball as well a goal that earned us a point against Nottingham Forest. Is Munoz raw? yes he is but it’s a natural pace and determined energy which saw him selected for the 2026 World Cup winning Spanish national squad.

articles.title: Taylor ecstatic with Croke Park swansong
articles.summary: Katie Taylor acclaimed becoming a three-time undisputed world champion in her farewell fight at Croke Park as the most special moment of her decorated career.
body: Katie Taylor beats Flora Pili in the final fight of her boxing career, becoming an undisputed world champion for the third time; the judges score it 100-90, 100-90, 98-91 as Taylor headlines first boxing event at Croke Park since Muhammad Ali fought Al “Blue” Lewis in 1972.
Taylor outclassed Flora Pili in a unanimous points victory in front of a crowd of 80,000 to ensure her three decades as an amateur and professional boxer ended in fairytale fashion.
Wild celebrations followed the announcement that she had overwhelmed the previously unbeaten Pili 100-90 100-90 98-91 on the scorecards.
For Taylor the feeling of signing off in front of her fans bettered winning Olympic gold at London 2012, headlining Madison Square Garden and her trilogy against Amanda Serrano.
